title: Dangerous Himalaya Landings, A220 Routes & Baltic Tours | MSFS Marketplace
description:
Ready to take on extreme mountain approaches, fly realistic commercial routes across South America, or inject authentic airline schedules into Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020? The Marketplace just rolled out a fresh wave of flight activities headlined by Perfect Flight's Himalaya Landings, structured Air France and LATAM rotations, global fleet schedules from VA Systems, and scenic tours highlighting World Update 23: Poland and the Baltics.

In this marketplace breakdown, we skip the storefront clutter and organize these arrivals into clear categories—highlighting key aircraft compatibility requirements and prerequisite warnings so you can plan your next flight without surprises:

✈️ STRUCTURED COMMERCIAL FLIGHTS & HIGH-ALTITUDE CHALLENGES (PERFECT FLIGHT)
Take command of pre-briefed airline legs and extreme approaches with authentic soundscapes and simulated in-flight events:

Advanced Challenges – Himalayas Landings: Test your piloting skills across 24 missions in the highest mountain range on earth. Attempt landings at the legendary 11.7% sloped runway at Lucla (Mount Everest) or the world's highest civilian jetport at Daocheng Yading. Features multiple tiers using aircraft ranging from the CubCrafters and PC-6 to the A320neo and 737.

12 Legs – AFR Fall 2026: Fly 12 distinct routes in the Air France livery featuring custom sounds, interactive menus, and realistic flight events. (⚠️ Prerequisite: Requires the Synaptic A220 livery pack / base or the VirtualCol A320 series to apply the livery and fly).

12 Legs – LATAM 2026: Execute 12 IFR missions across South America (Chile, Argentina, Brazil, Peru, and Colombia) complete with comprehensive pilot documentation and in-game briefs. (⚠️ Prerequisite: Utilizes the default A320neo—specifically NOT the iniBuilds A320neo V2).

🌐 REAL-WORLD AIRLINE & AIRPORT TIMETABLES (VA SYSTEMS)
Eliminate empty skies and inject real-world Summer 2026 airline schedules directly into your flight log:

Summer 2026 Airline Schedules: Dedicated route packages and airline liveries covering real-world operations for Air Europa, Air India, El Al, Eurowings, and Air Transat. (⚠️ Prerequisite: Requires owning the respective compatible aircraft models to fly the assigned legs).

Airport Schedules: Regional traffic injections and route packages bringing true-to-life scheduled commercial variety to major international hubs, including Helsinki Vantaa (EFHK), Philadelphia (KPHL), Queen Alia Amman (OJAI), Gold Coast (YBCG), and Shanghai Hongqiao (ZSSS).

🏔️ SCENIC BUSH TRIPS & REGIONAL EXCURSIONS (PERFECT FLIGHT)
Discover newly enhanced European landscapes, historic cities, and coastlines:

Poland and the Baltics (The Complete Bundle): Explore the entirety of the World Update 23 region. With Parts 3 (Lithuania) and 4 (Latvia/Estonia) launching this week, this bundle connects with Parts 1 and 2 to give you a massive, continuous VFR journey across Southern, Central, and Northern Poland, straight through the Baltics.

Whether you're managing tricky approaches in the Himalayas, flying authentic Summer 2026 timetables across the globe, or touring the Baltic coast on a relaxed VFR bush trip, these additions bring structured flight planning back to your simulator.

Which of these activity packs or schedule overhauls are you loading up first? Are you taking the commercial route or the excursion route? Drop your pick in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you navigate the latest MSFS 2020 additions, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
